scenes.title: Why is the sky blue?
scenes.text: Why is the sky blue, and not green?

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: Great question, Mel. Sunlight looks white, but it is really every colour mixed together.
Sunlight hits the air, and the air bounces it around before it reaches your eyes.

scenes.title: Blue scatters most
scenes.text: Blue light has short waves, so it scatters the most. That is why blue fills the whole sky.

stat.label: at sunset the light travels through more air

scenes.text: At sunset, light travels through much more air, so the blue is scattered away and red is left.
Got a why? Comment it and we will answer next.
